name: spellkave_render_scene
label: Render scene
description: Render a spellkave-scene/v1 data package, values and dependency TOML payloads into validated ordinary manifests and deterministic setup keys. Offline render never mutates or proves live admission. On a caller connection, preview pins a complete empty blueprint and the selected caller/world. Hosted calls accept payloads, never filesystem paths or executable packages.

package.description: Resolved spellkave-scene/v1 data package; no executable templates or filesystem paths.

values.description: Data values: anchor_id, optional bearing_deg and counts.

dependencies.description: Resolved dependency TOML payloads for offline validation.
